records.summary: Criterion-bound FND-001 review of build/configuration, tested agent workflow and honest research/provenance scope; A100 independently audited the definitions and source bindings.
records.command:
python tools/project.py validate
python tools/project.py sync --check
python tools/validate_data.py
python tools/check_docs.py
python tools/campaign.py validate
python tools/campaign.py sync --check
limitations: Software/documentary foundation only; specimen identity, calibrated measurements and owner-selected software license remain unavailable.
Metadata and hashes establish declared consistency, not experiment authenticity; cooperative coordination and trusted directories are assumed.
Hosted results in the report are explicitly tied to the earlier commit; no complete current three-platform CI result is claimed.

records.summary: All four PHY-001 analytic criteria mapped to independent scalar, state-continuity, combined-pickup, passive-network and invalid-input checks. Frozen clean clone passed 25 CTest and 171 Python tests; local sanitizer passed 25. Also supports FND-001 software verification.
records.command:
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build --config Release --parallel 2
ctest --test-dir build -C Release --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/python -v
cmake --preset sanitize
cmake --build --preset sanitize --parallel 2
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 ctest --preset sanitize --output-on-failure
limitations: Synthetic linear modes, impulse/switched-loss controls, polynomial linkage and resistive topology; no measured Rhodes fidelity.
Local LeakSanitizer disabled; native current Windows/macOS execution and minimum CMake version not established by local tests.
Finite contact, magnetic reaction, reactive circuits, induced arithmetic-fault recovery, antialiasing convergence and runtime deadlines remain outside this acceptance.

records.summary: Independent 208-run contact audit: all sampled oracle comparisons within budgets, but 26 final-step refinement checks fail and continuous-time extrema remain incomplete; PHY-002 is not complete.
limitations: Synthetic offline finite-mass p=1 model; no calibrated physical specimen. Eight tracked audited inputs exactly match the recorded commit; execution/source/input/binary hashes retained.
No independent continuous-time force/compression extrema acceptance. Twenty waveform or energy and six event-time refinement monotonicity failures remain under the frozen matrix.

records.summary: Reproducible actual VST3 callback observation matrix: 3600 successful calls, 433 independent accounting checks, two nominal block-period overruns; this records observed performance and does not complete RT-001.
limitations: One shuffled 12-cell matrix in an uncontrolled Linux x86-64 container; 48/192 kHz, 64 frames, 73 keys, three workloads, both formats, 300 measured callbacks per cell. No causal format comparison or worst-case deadline guarantee.

Direct callable adapter measurements exclude module loading, commercial DAWs, audio-device scheduling and allocation/locking verification. Exact source, binary, archive, compiler flags and available hardware metadata are retained.

records.summary: Five-key synthetic resampling diagnostic observes a predicted folded high-register component, but filter/onset/export limits prevent a complete timestep or antialiasing acceptance bound. RT-001 remains incomplete.
limitations: Five single-note keys at velocity0.7, 48/96/192 kHz and declared onset/held windows only. Synthetic volts and coefficients; no specimen calibration or audibility claim.

Finite-rate FIR reference, zero-extension at onset and float32 WAV export affect differences. A fitted folded component is diagnostic evidence, not a certified alias-only bound or proof over the supported operating domain.
